rules.body: MUST use Conventional Commits format for all commits (type(scope): description). Types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert.
MUST format all Go source files with gofumpt before committing.
MUST pass golangci-lint v2 with the linters configured in .golangci.yml (errcheck, gocritic, govet, ineffassign, staticcheck).
MUST wrap an underlying error with %w when returning it so callers can inspect the cause with errors.Is and errors.As.
